# Crowd Control triggers

## Coin exchange

Runs when someone gets Crowd Control coins, bought or free. Handy to thank people who buy coins.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Coin type** | Choose paid (coins bought with real money), free (earned for free) or Any. Options: Any, paid, free. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Minimum coins** | Only run when at least this many coins were added. 0 means any amount. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who got the coins |
| `%coinType%` | paid or free |
| `%amount%` | How many coins |
| `%bonus%` | Extra bonus coins |
| `%source%` | Where the coins came from |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.coinExchange`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to Crowd Control. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to Crowd Control. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.disconnected`</small>

## Effect failure

Runs when a Crowd Control effect could not happen in your game.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Effects** | Only run for these effects. Type effect names (or ids) separated by commas, like "Spawn Creeper". Leave empty for any effect. |
| **Games** | Only run for these games. Type game names (or ids) separated by commas. Leave empty for any game. |
| **Minimum price (coins)** | Only run when the effect cost at least this many Crowd Control coins. 0 means any price. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The viewer who asked ("Anonymous" if hidden) |
| `%effectName%` | The effect's name |
| `%effectDescription%` | What the effect does |
| `%price%` | What it cost, in coins |
| `%quantity%` | How many times they asked for it |
| `%gameName%` | The game |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%requestId%` | The number of this request |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |
| `%temporary%` | True if it failed only for now and may work later |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.effectFailure`</small>

## Game session end

Runs when a Crowd Control play session ends.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%gameName%` | The game |
| `%gamePackName%` | The Crowd Control game pack being used |
| `%gameSessionId%` | The number of this play session |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.gameSessionEnd`</small>

## Game session paused / resumed

Runs when you pause or resume a Crowd Control play session.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Paused** | Choose Any to run for both. On runs only when the session gets paused. Off runs only when it resumes. Options: Any, On, Off. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%gameName%` | The game |
| `%gamePackName%` | The Crowd Control game pack being used |
| `%gameSessionId%` | The number of this play session |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |
| `%paused%` | True if it is now paused, false if it resumed |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.gameSessionPaused`</small>

## Game session start

Runs when a Crowd Control play session starts, so viewers can begin to send effects.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Games** | Only run for these games. Type game names (or ids) separated by commas. Leave empty for any game. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%gameName%` | The game |
| `%gamePackName%` | The Crowd Control game pack being used |
| `%gameSessionId%` | The number of this play session |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.gameSessionStart`</small>
